segments.he: אָמַר רַב שֵׁשֶׁת: אַכְסְנַאי חַיָּיב בְּנֵר חֲנוּכָּה. אָמַר רַבִּי זֵירָא: מֵרֵישׁ כִּי הֲוֵינָא בֵּי רַב, מִשְׁתַּתַּפְנָא בִּפְרִיטֵי בַּהֲדֵי אוּשְׁפִּיזָא. בָּתַר דִּנְסֵיבִי אִיתְּתָא, אָמֵינָא: הַשְׁתָּא וַדַּאי לָא צְרִיכְנָא, דְּקָא מַדְלְקִי עֲלַי בְּגוֹ בֵּיתַאי.
segments.en: «Rav Sheshet said: A guest is obligated in» lighting «the Hanukkah light» in the place where he is being hosted. The Gemara relates that «Rabbi Zeira said: At first, when I was» studying «in the yeshiva, I would participate with perutot,» copper coins, «together with the host [ushpiza],» so that I would be a partner in the light that he kindled. «After I married» my «wife, I said: Now I certainly need not» do so because «they light on my behalf in my house.»
